assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered.
The service is medically necessary to determine whether an arrhythmia explains the transient cerebral ischemic events.
The transient cerebral ischemic events are reflected in diagnosis code G45.9.
The condition is reflected in diagnosis code I48.0.
